slides.headline: “your sign changed because of ophiuchus”
slides.body: your sign hasn't changed. western astrology uses the tropical zodiac: twelve equal slices starting at the march equinox. it follows the seasons, not the star patterns.

slides.headline: the sun does pass through *ophiuchus*. that's not news
slides.body: the constellations are unequal and the sun crosses thirteen of them. earth's slow wobble has also shifted them against the seasons over centuries. signs and constellations are two maps.

slides.headline: tropical astrology never used the *stars* that way
slides.body: astrologers read signs as seasons of the year. by that map the sun is in pisces right now, and you're still the sign you were last week.

slides.headline: same sign. same chance to say the *honest* thing.
